1\\. Provide acquisition design review support with sustainment focus.

Skechers is seeking a Senior Analyst to join our IT Infrastructure \\& Operations team, supporting and helping to establish the Software Asset Management (SAM) program. * Help develop and maintain SAM policies, standards, procedures, and governance frameworks (ISO 19770, ITAM standards)

Lead execution of end\\-to\\-end SAM processes: procurement request deployment monitoring* optimization compliance retirement.

* Support evaluation, implementation, and management of SAM tools. Integrate with existing ITSM/CMDB systems, endpoint management, cloud platforms, HR, and financial systems

* Analyze software usage data, SaaS subscription data, and license consumption patterns to identify trends and optimization opportunities
* Lead development of comprehensive reports and dashboards on software inventory, compliance status, utilization, risk, and cost metrics

* Establish and track SAM metrics and KPIs (cost per license, utilization rates, compliance scores)

* Lead software audits, license true\\-ups, and coordinate vendor audit response preparation including documentation, data packages, and remediation plans
* Identify and help mitigate software compliance risks and security vulnerabilities
* Support primary vendor liaison activities and participate in licensing negotiations
* Maintain comprehensive audit trails, compliance documentation and playbooks
* Coordinate with hardware asset management to ensure proper license reclamation and reassignment

* Proven experience supporting SAM programs and leading compliance initiatives
* Strong knowledge of software licensing models (perpetual, subscription, user, device, consumption\\-based, SaaS) and SAM tools (ServiceNow, Flexera, or similar Service Management platforms)
* Strong understanding of virtualization, cloud computing, and ITIL frameworks
* Experience leading process improvement and program development initiatives
* Experience with data analysis and reporting; proficiency with advanced Excel and/or analytics/scripting tools (e.g., SQL, Power BI, or similar) is highly desirable

* **Preferred:** CSAM (Certified Software Asset Manager) or working toward certification
* **Preferred:** ITIL Foundation or higher

* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder influence skills
* Detail\\-oriented with excellent documentation and organizational capabilities including maintaining policies, procedures, and audit evidence
* Ability to lead independent initiatives and manage multiple priorities
* Experience working in cross\\-functional teams and leading stakeholder engagement, governance forums, and training sessions

PINT is a digital agency that strives to maintain the continuum of thoughtful, web standards\\-driven development that makes the internet the predominant communication medium of our day.


We are engineering\\-focused practitioners with a long tradition of building maintainable, robust websites and applications that serve some of the largest organizations in the world.

* We're not satisfied by black box PPC and analytics…we want to own real web traffic insights based on supportable data
* We want to target specific outcomes, not just "line go up"
* Website performance is as important as, and will drive, conversion numbers

The Research, Analytics, and Data office is accepting applications for a Senior Analyst. This position provides advanced policy, analytical, and technical support for data initiatives related to the Judicial Branch Statistical Information System (JBSIS). JBSIS defines and collects statewide summary information for each major case processing area of the court and makes court data available via the JBSIS data warehouse. It is the basis of the annual Court Statistics Report, facilitates trial court budget allocation via staff and judicial workload studies, and informs and structures countless other Judicial Council outputs and services.


The Senior Analyst leads projects focused on delivering strategic value from JBSIS, including data validation and analysis, collaborating with IT and subject matter experts on technical enhancements, coordinating with other offices impacted by JBSIS, stewarding data reporting rules, and guiding courts and case management system vendors through data mapping processes. The Senior Analyst position serves as staff to the JBSIS Subcommittee of the Judicial Council’s Court Executives Advisory Committee, providing research and policy support to guide and implement the vision of branch leaders. It consults with other parts of the Judicial Council on the use of JBSIS data for branch policy making and reporting requirements. And it is responsible for JBSIS data governance, developing policies and products that maximize public access to justice while safeguarding data sensitivity.


This work is conducted independently with limited supervision in support of major initiatives that have statewide impact.

**The Judicial Council**  

The Judicial Council of California is the policy setting body for the state court system and has constitutionally conferred statewide rule\\-making authority. This authority includes developing, advocating for, and allocating the judicial branch budget. A majority of Council members are California state justices and judges; however, the Council also includes lawyers, legislators, and court administrators.


By enhancing its role as a leadership, knowledge, and service resource for the judicial branch, the Judicial Council’s staff organization seeks to continue to evolve as one of California’s most dynamic public service entities, focused on improving access to justice for all Californians by innovating and responding to the changing needs of the courts and the public. As a government body charged with improving the statewide administration of justice, the Judicial Council has multiple offices with diverse responsibilities relating to court policy and operations. As employees of the council, every member of staff should view and approach their work as one Judicial Council with a public service mission that is greater than the sum of its parts.


The Judicial Council strives for work life balance and includes substantial vacation and holiday time. In addition, we offer an excellent benefits package including pension, medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible spending, up to $130 per month reimbursement for qualifying commuting costs, student loan forgiveness as part of Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), and retirement savings plans. In San Francisco, the office is only a 7\\-minute walk from the downtown Civic Center BART station. In Sacramento, the office is located minutes from downtown, just north of Discovery Park.


The Judicial Council offers hybrid work arrangements for many positions. The successful candidate will be expected to work in person at the Judicial Council’s San Francisco office at least two days per week, based on their office leader’s direction, and reside in the areas surrounding these locations. To be eligible for Judicial Council employment and participation in the Judicial Council’s Hybrid Work Program, a prospective or current employee’s primary residence/remote work location must be in the State of California and within a 150\\-mile driving radius of their assigned reporting location.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------

  


* Overseeing and leading JBSIS data collection, validation, and analytics.
* Leading the development and implementation of JBSIS data governance policies and practices.
* Supporting JBSIS data reporting and auditing processes.
* Providing analytic, policy, and administrative support to the JBSIS Subcommittee of the Court Executives Advisory Committee.
* Serving as an internal data analytics consultant and technical resource for courts and the Judicial Council.


**Qualifications**
------------------

  


Bachelor’s degree and four (4\\) years of analytical experience in program analysis, development,

The incumbent will work independently and in collaboration with CBR staff and faculty investigators to facilitate multiple research projects and CBR efforts.

 **GENERAL PURPOSE OF THE JOB:**


Southern California University of Health Sciences (SCUHS) runs on a complex ecosystem of people, processes, and technology platforms. The gap between what the university needs and what its systems actually deliver is where institutional friction lives—missed deadlines, workarounds, manual effort that shouldn’t exist, and decisions made without the right information. The Business Analyst exists to close that gap.


This is not a documentation role or an observer role. You will sit squarely between our stakeholder groups—faculty, administrators, department chairs, clinical leaders—and the technology platforms that serve them: Jenzabar, Canvas, Athena, and the Microsoft Fabric data platform. You will understand problems deeply, design better processes, assess whether proposed technology changes will actually solve them, and see solutions through to working reality. You own the outcomes.


Think of this role like a general contractor. The architect (the stakeholder) has a vision. The tradespeople (vendors and technology teams) have the skills. Your job is to turn the vision into a buildable plan, hold everyone to it, and make sure what gets built is what was actually needed—not just what was literally requested.

 **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**:


You are someone who is equally comfortable sitting with a registrar trying to understand why a grade submission process breaks every term and sitting with a Jenzabar implementation consultant reviewing whether a proposed configuration will actually fix it. * **A Natural Communicator:** You adapt instinctively: with a financial aid director you speak about process and students; with a Jenzabar consultant, functional configuration and data flow; with the CIO, risk and institutional outcome. You are never the person who lets a project go quiet.

**About the Job**

* Processes are clearly documented, adopted, and consistently followed.

* Compliance gaps are identified early and fully resolved.
* Teams execute with greater consistency and less ambiguity.

description:
**Description**


### **Position Summary**


This role is a hands\\-on analytical position supporting Process Accounting with a focus on investigating complex account issues, executing remediation analyses, and ensuring accuracy across customer, transaction, and program\\-level data. The analyst will translate business rules into scalable SQL logic, perform root\\-cause analysis, and support fix\\-forward solutions in partnership with IT, Risk, ERS, and cross\\-functional teams. Success in this role requires strong technical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate insights clearly to both technical and non\\-technical stakeholders, and disciplined documentation to ensure fixes are correct and audit\\-ready.

### **Summary of Essential Job Functions**

* Construct and execute advanced Snowflake/SQL queries to investigate cardholder account issues and error conditions
* Triage incoming remediation requests, confirm intake form completeness, and request missing details when needed
* Diagnose what error occurred, when it occurred, and why it occurred by analyzing account history, system outputs, and related datasets
* Determine the appropriate remediation approach (data correction, system update, process fix, or escalation) and coordinate execution
* Validate impacted populations using defined criteria, and when criteria is unclear, develop logic to identify impacted populations and quantify scope
* Perform population validation, reconciliation, and data quality checks to confirm accuracy prior to remediation and after remediation completion
* Research unexplained variances in reporting or account behavior and translate findings into actionable next steps
* Produce recurring reports, dashboards, and executive summaries related to remediation volume, drivers, trends, and outcomes
* Document investigation next steps, logic, and remediation decisions so work is repeatable and defensible for stakeholders and audit needs
* Communicate clearly with business partners on status, scope, root cause, remediation plan, timing, and risks
* Collaborate cross\\-functionally to identify process improvement opportunities, reduce recurring defects, and improve intake quality
* Prepare materials (PowerPoint summaries, readouts, and written updates) for T\\&F leadership and partner teams as needed
* Perform other duties as assigned

### **Position Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Analytics, Information Systems, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related field
* 2 to 4 years of experience in data analysis using SQL, including query building and reporting
* Strong proficiency with SQL and relational data concepts (joins, aggregations, filtering logic, data validation techniques)
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (Power Pivot, formulas; macros a plus)
* Experience working with structured and unstructured data in warehouse environments
* Ability to interpret business rules and translate them into clear population definitions and validation logic
* Strong problem\\-solving skills with an investigative mindset and comfort working ambiguous issues to resolution
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings to non\\-technical stakeholders
* Ability to manage multiple remediation efforts simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and documentation discipline
* Familiarity with BI and reporting tools (Tableau, SharePoint, or similar)
* Experience in financial services, card/transaction data, or regulatory remediation work a plus

Required**:**

* Ability to obtain and maintain the required Workday certification(s)
* 2\\+ years of experience supporting Workday HCM reporting discovery, rationalization, and design sessions
* 3\\+ years of experience working with databases such as SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar, performing data entry, queries, reporting, or data analysis, including using VLOOKUP to locate information within spreadsheets
* 2\\+ years of experience with at least one programming or scripting language such as Java, .NET, Python, or similar
* Ability to travel up to 50\\-75%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

* Active Workday Reporting certification preferred

title: Research Analyst, Data & Intelligence Products
description:
**About The Information**


The Information is a proprietary news and intelligence platform trusted by over one million technology and finance leaders. Our newsroom produces exclusive, deeply reported data on private companies, dealmaking, executive moves, and industry trends that don't exist anywhere else. We're building a new business line to package this intelligence into products for enterprises, investors, and advisory firms — and we need a sharp, curious analyst to help turn raw editorial intelligence into structured, sellable data.

 **The Opportunity:**


Every day, our reporters and surveys generate intelligence that hedge funds, corp dev teams, consultants, and venture firms would pay real money for. Your job is to work at the intersection of the newsroom and the product team — extracting, structuring, and enriching the proprietary data that powers our intelligence products. Think: company profiles built from exclusive reporting, deal activity timelines, sentiment data from our leadership network, and sector benchmarks drawn from original survey research.


This is a ground\\-floor role on a small team building something new. You'll have more ownership and visibility than you'd get in three years at a large data or research firm.

**What You'll Do:**

* Extract and structure intelligence from editorial reporting, surveys, and proprietary datasets into clean, consistent formats (company profiles, deal timelines, executive moves, sector benchmarks).
* Build and maintain taxonomies, tagging systems, and data schemas that make our intelligence searchable and usable at scale.
* Enrich and validate proprietary data — cross\\-referencing our reporting against public filings, funding databases, and industry sources.
* Help develop new intelligence offerings with survey data from our network of senior tech and finance leaders, identifying trends and signals that feed into intelligence products. By month four you will have launched a new recurring data feed for enterprise clients.
* Work closely with reporters and editors to identify which stories and datasets have the highest commercial value and ensure data quality.
* Support product development by preparing datasets, building prototypes (dashboards, reports, data feeds), and helping define what buyers actually need.

**What You Bring:**

* 1–3 years of experience in a research, data, or analyst role — at a data/intelligence company, consulting firm, investment firm, media research team, or similar environment. Internships count if the work was substantive.
* Strong data skills. You're comfortable working with messy, semi\\-structured data and turning it into something clean and usable. Proficiency in Excel is a given; experience with SQL, Python, or similar tools is a plus.
* Fluency with AI and LLM tools. You use ChatGPT, Claude, or similar tools as part of your daily workflow — for research, data extraction, summarization, or prototyping. You have good instincts for where AI accelerates the work and where human judgment is essential.
* Research rigor. You know how to find, verify, and contextualize information. You care about accuracy and can tell when something doesn't add up.
* Familiarity with the tech and business landscape. You follow the industry — you know the difference between a Series B and a growth round, you can name the major players in enterprise AI, and you understand why proprietary intelligence about private companies is valuable.
* Clear communication. You can write a concise summary, explain a dataset to a non\\-technical stakeholder, and flag issues without being asked.
* Builder mentality. You want to be early at something, not plugged into an existing machine. You're comfortable with ambiguity and motivated by the prospect of shaping a new product from the ground up.

**Why This Role**

* **Unmatched data.** You'll work with intelligence that can't be scraped, crowdsourced, or generated by AI — sourced directly from original reporting and a network of over a million senior leaders.
* **Outsized ownership.** On a small team, your work directly shapes the product. You won't be formatting slides for someone else's presentation.
* **Learn the business.** You'll get exposure to enterprise product development, go\\-to\\-market strategy, and how intelligence companies operate — a career accelerator whether you stay in data, move into product, or go the investor route.
* **A proven market.** AlphaSense, PitchBook, and CB Insights have built multi\\-billion\\-dollar businesses selling intelligence to enterprises. You'll help build the version built on truly proprietary, editorially sourced data.

**Benefits:**

**We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support the well\\-being of our employees and their families, including:**

* Company\\-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their dependents
* Medical coverage that includes fertility care and $0 copays for in\\-office mental health visits with in\\-network providers

* Fitness and wellness stipend to encourage a healthy lifestyle
* Monthly cell phone reimbursement
* Company\\-sponsored lunches in the office every Monday

**Examples of Duties**
----------------------


**Merced County Department of Administrative Services – Information Systems is currently accepting applications for the position of Supervising Network Systems Support Analyst within the Network, Communications, and Enterprise Systems Division. This is a critical supervisorial position within Information Systems, and plays an integral role in the agency’s communicating, planning, initiating, collaborating, maintaining, and evaluating activities related to the County’s network infrastructure, telecommunications systems, enterprise server environments, and cybersecurity infrastructure. This position requires dynamic professional leadership as well as strong technical experience in designing, deploying, and maintaining these infrastructures. Demonstrated experience in coaching team members to strengthen their abilities and skill sets is desirable.** **Duties may include, but are not limited to the following:**  

  

**Network Services:**
Supervise IS Network Services Division in the design, implementation and maintenance of all Network Services Systems.  

* 

Design and manage the implementation and maintenance of network and telephony systems. This includes but is not limited to: definition and documentation of requirements; development of methods and procedures; project coordination; development of plans and schedules; resource management, deployment and maintenance.  
* 

Maintenance and testing of policies and procedures to ensure that all data center systems have the latest anti\\-virus software data files and are updated regularly.  
* 

Determine the impact of software applications on network/system resources and make recommendations; implement and document any changes.  
* 

Supervise the planning, coordination and documentation of routine telephone maintenance.  
* 

Provide system and network resource monitoring and reporting.  
* 

Develop and enhance the skills and experience of Network Services personnel with specific security responsibilities to ensure that systems remain secure, available and functional at all times.  
* 
* Maintain network and server availability to meet customer needs.

**Service Desk:**
Service Desk Case Management System. Develops, oversees, implements and maintains the IT Service Desk Case Management Systems.
